description: This file defines the class ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller, which facilitates pulling SugarCRM module records (SugarBeans) from the database, supporting differential and full data pulls, with batch processing and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller
classes.description: A class for extracting SugarCRM module records for Elasticsearch indexing, supporting differential updates, batch processing, and filtering by modification time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the data puller with a specified module, differential run flag, and logger.

methods.name: setLastIndexTime
methods.description: Sets the last index time used for differential data pulling.

methods.name: setShowDeleted
methods.description: Configures whether to include deleted records in the pull.

methods.name: setDifferential
methods.description: Sets whether the data pull should be differential, affecting filter generation.

methods.name: pullNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of records from the module, updating offset and count.

methods.name: generateWhere
methods.description: Constructs the SQL WHERE clause for filtering records based on differential status and last index time.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method for dynamic property access.
